text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While visiting a tourist spot on a solo trip,
I spotted some familiar faces, including Karston Light O.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Now then. Shall we head to the teahouse next and take a breather?

text_block_list.name: Teahouse Staff
text_block_list.text:
Here is your matcha and tea sweets.
Please enjoy the sweets first, and take your time relishing the tea.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wah, looks so delicious~♪
Well then, starting with the sweets—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sweet sweet sweet!
*Gulp gulp gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeehh!? You chugged it all in one go!?

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
This is our inn's signature course meal.
Please start with the appetizer and soup.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It has such a lovely atmosphere.
Well then, let's take our time enjoying it—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious delicious delicious!
*Gulp gulp gulp*. Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh!? Y-You're already done eating...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You have no appreciation for wabi-sabi whatsoever...
This is a vacation, so please calm down...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Umm, that takes care of everything we needed to do here.
Alright, let's move on to the next sightseeing spot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We're taking the "scenic sightseeing train", right?
Light O-chan booked it for us, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I booked it.
Though it's not a sightseeing train, it's a limited express train.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pardon?
............A limited express train?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's right. A limited express is fast and runs in a straight line.
It's much better than taking a detour.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Wh—
What in the world are you doing~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*ROOOOOOOAAAAAAR—!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...
It is remarkably fast, immensely so............

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, super fast...
Well, but we can still kind of see the scenery... maybe...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Right... yeah. Since we're here, let's just enjoy the scenery we can see right now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Eh, no way! Um... everyone!
It looks like the sightseeing train is suspended...! Due to heavy rain!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah, you're right...! Suspended due to heavy rain, currently no estimate for resumption, it says...!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh, so—if we had tried to take the sightseeing train, we would have been stranded, right?
Several tens of minutes later—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's sunny over here! There are way fewer people than usual—what a huge chance!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, looks like we can get into that footbath over there right away.
Shall we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm in, I'm in~! Let's go to the footbath together, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~!
That felt so good, all warm and toasty!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we had the whole place to ourselves and could truly relax.
This is all thanks to Light O-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. For today at least, it seems I must express my gratitude, Light O-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I have always been dragged around and bewildered by your antics, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Today, thanks to you booking the limited express, we were all able to have a wonderful time. —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
You're speaking unusually straightforward and honestly today.
Are you gunning for my title of "Straight-Line Boss"?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Sorry to say, but I won't hand it over. My posture is much straighter anyway. STIIIIIIFFFFF!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I'm not gunning for anything, honestly...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, you will surely remain true to who you are.
And that is fine—both the good and the bad included.

On my way back, I caught sight of Karston Light O and the others once again.
Judging by their fulfilled expressions, they must have thoroughly enjoyed their trip.
